title: Max health
prompt: Members `health` at 90 and `max_health` at 100 exist. Write `heal`, which adds an amount to health and then, if health went above max_health, sets it back to max_health. solve calls heal(30) and returns health, which stays at 100.
starter:
var health = 90
var max_health = 100

func solve():
	return health
hints: Add first, then check the cap.

docs.name: var name = value (outside any function)
docs.what: A member variable: every function in the script can read and change it.
